参赛完成，不作为奖项展示
英文数学建模项目经历
核心建模负责人；辅助编程与论文写作

blocks.text: 该英文建模项目以阿拉斯加 Juneau 的过度旅游问题为背景，构建兼顾旅游收入、环境质量、基础设施承载力和居民满意度的动态多目标优化模型，并通过税收—支出反馈机制分析可持续旅游管理策略。

blocks.alt: 可持续旅游模型整体建模框架
blocks.caption: 图：项目整体建模框架，展示从动态多目标模型构建、多目的地适配、游客分流推荐到敏感性分析的完整流程。

blocks.text: Juneau 在邮轮旅游快速增长的同时面临环境退化、基础设施压力和居民满意度下降等问题。项目要求构建可持续旅游模型，明确优化目标与约束，设计额外收入的支出反馈方案，并将模型推广到其他存在过度旅游问题的目的地。

blocks.caption: 核心建模模块
rows: 刻画游客数量、环境质量、基础设施健康度、居民满意度和旅游收入之间的动态关系
收益最大化 + 环境与基础设施压力最小化
在经济收益、环境保护和居民福利之间建立约束平衡
税收与可持续支出分配
将旅游收入的一部分投入环境保护、基础设施改善和社区项目
地理类型分类与参数调整
将目的地划分为环境敏感型、文化遗产型和城市休闲型
景点评分公式 + 推荐优先级函数
提高小众景点曝光，缓解热门景点过载
单变量敏感性分析 + 全局敏感性分析
识别环境敏感系数和税率等关键参数

blocks.caption: 结果摘要
rows: 主动管理情景下，环境质量、基础设施健康度和居民满意度趋于稳定，旅游收入保持增长趋势
可持续支出分配为 50% 环境保护、30% 基础设施改善、20% 社区项目
以 Iceland 为环境敏感型目的地案例，调整环境敏感系数和基础设施参数
通过小众景点评分与游客分流机制，降低热门景点压力
完成面向 Juneau Tourism Council 的 memorandum，形成政策建议表达

blocks.caption: 图：基准情景与主动管理情景下游客数量、居民满意度、环境质量和基础设施健康度的变化对比。

blocks.caption: 图：景点推荐优先级三维空间图，用于展示游客兴趣匹配、景点评分和拥挤惩罚共同作用下的分流推荐机制。

blocks.alt: 干预前后游客分布热力图
blocks.caption: 图：干预前后游客分布热力图，展示小众景点推荐机制对游客空间分布的调节作用。

blocks.text: 我负责该作品的全部核心建模工作，包括动态系统方程、多目标优化目标与约束、税收—支出反馈机制、景点评分模型、游客分流推荐模型和敏感性分析设计，并辅助英文论文写作、图表整理与结果解释。

rows: Construction of Sustainable Tourism Model from the Perspective of Dynamic Multi-objective Optimization
Completed entry; not presented as an award
Lead modeler; assisted with programming and paper writing

blocks.text: This English modeling project uses overtourism in Juneau, Alaska as its context. It builds a dynamic multi-objective optimization model balancing tourism revenue, environmental quality, infrastructure capacity, and resident satisfaction, and analyzes sustainable management strategies through a tax-expenditure feedback mechanism.

blocks.alt: Overall modeling framework for sustainable tourism
blocks.caption: Figure: Overall modeling framework, covering dynamic multi-objective modeling, multi-destination adaptation, tourist redistribution recommendation, and sensitivity analysis.

blocks.text: Juneau faces environmental degradation, infrastructure pressure, and declining resident satisfaction alongside rapid cruise-tourism growth. The task required constructing a sustainable tourism model, defining objectives and constraints, designing a feedback plan for additional revenue expenditure, and adapting the model to other overtourism destinations.

blocks.caption: Core Modeling Modules
rows: Captures interactions among tourist volume, environmental quality, infrastructure health, resident satisfaction, and tourism revenue
Revenue maximization plus minimization of environmental and infrastructure pressure
Balances economic benefit, environmental protection, and resident welfare
Allocates part of tourism revenue to environmental protection, infrastructure improvement, and community projects
Classifies destinations as environmentally sensitive, cultural heritage, or urban leisure sites
Increases exposure for lesser-known attractions and reduces overload at popular sites
Identifies key parameters such as environmental sensitivity and tax rate

blocks.caption: Result Summary
rows: Under active management, environmental quality, infrastructure health, and resident satisfaction tended to stabilize while tourism revenue continued to grow
Sustainable expenditure was allocated as 50% environmental protection, 30% infrastructure improvement, and 20% community projects
Iceland was modeled as an environmentally sensitive destination with adjusted environmental and infrastructure parameters
A scoring and tourist-redistribution mechanism was used to reduce pressure on popular attractions
A memorandum to the Juneau Tourism Council was prepared with actionable policy recommendations

blocks.alt: Comparison between baseline and active management scenarios
blocks.caption: Figure: Comparison of tourist volume, resident satisfaction, environmental quality, and infrastructure health under baseline and active management scenarios.
Figure: Recommendation priority in 3D space, illustrating the redistribution mechanism driven by tourist-interest matching, attraction scoring, and crowding penalty.

blocks.alt: Tourist distribution heatmap before and after intervention
blocks.caption: Figure: Tourist distribution heatmap before and after intervention, showing how the recommendation mechanism redistributes visitor flow.

blocks.text: I was responsible for all core modeling work, including the dynamic system equations, multi-objective objectives and constraints, tax-expenditure feedback mechanism, attraction scoring model, tourist-redistribution recommendation model, and sensitivity-analysis design. I also assisted with English paper writing, figure organization, and result interpretation.
